evidence: Ti(Al)N thin films were deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD) from titanium tetrachloride, ammonia, and trimethylaluminum. The most important role of trimethylaluminum was to act as an extra reducing agent in order to lower the required deposition temperature. Nitrogen (99.9995 %) generated by a Nitrox UHPN 3000 nitrogen generator was used both as a carrier and a purging gas.
